description: An HTML documentation page containing embedded Tcl source code for the 'whois' module of a CodeMirror Tcl mode. It defines a user interface for a syntax-highlighted code editor and includes the Tcl source code implementing the 'whois' IRC bot functionality.

methods.name: whois::311
methods.description: Handles IRC '311' numeric response, providing host and realname info for a user.

methods.name: whois::multi
methods.description: Processes multiple raw IRC messages related to the 'whois' info, displaying additional notes.

methods.name: whois::317
methods.description: Handles '317' numeric, providing idle and signon times.

methods.name: whois::307
methods.description: Handles '307' numeric, indicating registered nick services.

methods.name: whois::list
methods.description: Handles the command binding for '|whois', initiating a WHOIS query for a user.
